**Finding: missing (critical) — no indemnification clause in the Agreement.**

The document jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability); Section 20 has been dropped entirely. Searches for "indemnif", "defend", "hold harmless" and "infring" surface only orphan cross-references that assume an indemnity exists:

- § 9.3 — termination right where Vendor "infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by **Section 20.5**"
- § 19.4 — remedy "not exclusive for ... indemnified claims"
- § 21.3 — "indemnification obligations" treated as Excluded Claims (uncapped)
- § 30.5 — preserves "vested indemnity rights"

With no Vendor IP indemnity at all, this is walk-away territory, not merely below fallback. I inserted a new Section 20 after § 19.5 at the preferred position: Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; customary exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, Customer specifications); standard notice/control/cooperation procedure; procure-modify-replace-refund remedies numbered **20.5** so the § 9.3 cross-reference resolves; and a narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. The redline validated ok:true and the finding is submitted.
